question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61df0d29bd97e4a0a35ecef179e2aa91121d049f558b400167fd00614abb406a.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa5013b498408bed75b8d7ee978aa0b34ae2f43ce7d0d7ebcb2059d8790dbe8b.png] 

⇒ (1 + 5) + (1 + 8) + (4 + 0) = 19.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e10cea9d1fbd230bd24e2f82cac921260c8856510ce150861c50886884bb666d.png] 

⇒ (2 + 2) + (4 + 1) + (5 + 7) = 21.

Similarly,

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a76949de5e83a87a5ba65c9d2db713d11be19cf9764704a4684c6d6bbe71b01.png] 

⇒ (4 + 5) + (8 + 7) + (2 + 9) = 35.

So, '**35**' will replace the question mark from the given question figure.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
